registration: prospective local protocol, not an external registry
scope: paper-aligned reconstruction of one fp32 epsilon setting, followed by conditional distillation; not the full precision/epsilon table

implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.input: two tokens [a,b], shared token embedding, learned two-position embedding, read last position
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.attention: causal, manual scaled dot product, biases enabled, no dropout
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.initialization: PyTorch defaults for embedding/linear; position normal std 0.02
implementation_choices_not_specified_by_.decay: all parameters, including biases and embeddings

pairing: standard and fixed arms copy identical initial weights and use the same split
teacher_selection: final fixed-arm checkpoint for each seed, no selection of an earlier or best checkpoint
acceptance: complete planned arms, epochs and checkpoints; verify source/config/splits/model tensors and recompute final predictions independently; desired superiority is not a completion criterion
downstream_rule: if final teacher accuracy is below 0.95, explicitly SKIP its distillation; never substitute a seed or cherry-pick a checkpoint
analysis: all seeds shown; descriptive comparison, no significance test or full-paper MATCH claim
